name: Telescope Array hybrid detector

placements.quote: 16 years of data collected from 11 May 2008 to 10 May 2024
placements.note: Placement point is the approximate campus/central point; the physical array is spread over ~700 km^2 (TAx4: ~3000 km^2) around Delta, Utah.

technology.value: Hybrid detector: an array of plastic scintillation surface detectors on a square grid, cross-checked by fluorescence telescopes at three sites imaging the ultraviolet light of air-shower development.
technology.quote: The original TA surface detector (SD) array consists of 507 plastic scintillation counters deployed on a 1.2 km square grid... observed by fluorescence detectors (FDs) at three sites

description.value: 38 fluorescence telescopes at three sites (Middle Drum, Long Ridge, Black Rock Mesa) imaging the longitudinal development of air showers; TAx4 adds 12 new FD telescopes.
description.quote: fluorescence detectors (FDs) at three sites, Middle Drum, Long Ridge, and Black Rock Mesa, with a total of 38 telescopes for hybrid measurements

summary.plain: More than 500 ground sensors spread across the Utah desert, watched by telescopes at three stations, working together to catch and study the rarest cosmic-ray particles.
summary.technical: Hybrid surface-detector/fluorescence-detector system: 507 scintillator counters on a 1.2 km grid over ~700 km^2, plus 38 fluorescence telescopes at three sites; extended since 2019 by TAx4 (500 further counters on a 2.08 km grid, 12 new FD telescopes, ~3000 km^2 target coverage).
